# Sevra

> AI-powered crisis management platform that helps transportation operators detect, decide, and respond to reputation crises in real time.

Sevra brings together social monitoring, crisis-level scoring (L0–L4), AI-drafted statements, approvals, and distribution in one workspace — built for crisis teams at airlines, rail and transit operators, bus and coach companies, ferry and shipping lines, ride-hailing services, and freight and logistics providers.

The workspace adapts to the operator's mode of transport: incident fields, AI classification, and drafted communications all use the vocabulary of the specific operation.
